purpose: zero-network rejection-first test of whether an exactly three-leg Binance Spot conversion through two distinct intermediaries improves on the best feasible direct or exactly one-intermediary route for an independently required organic conversion

retained_source.reuse_rule: verify every retained response against its durable receipt and issue zero HTTP requests

universe.direct_edges: every retained current TRADING Binance Spot directed edge with MARKET support and positive lot step
universe.three_leg_paths: every direct source-to-target pair having source-to-first-intermediary, first-to-second-intermediary, and second-to-target edges with four distinct assets
universe.comparator: at each saved snapshot and size use the greater of the feasible direct route and every feasible exactly one-intermediary route under the same fees, rounding, residual, capacity, and per-extra-leg stress
universe.selection_rule: enumerate the complete rule-defined population before viewing any two-intermediary outcome and never select assets or paths from the retained one-intermediary candidates

execution_model.quantity_rounding: floor each submitted base quantity to the retained positive MARKET_LOT_SIZE step or LOT_SIZE fallback
execution_model.capacity: direct and all path legs must fit their displayed retained top quantity
execution_model.residuals: retain source and both intermediary residuals and value each through its same-snapshot conservative direct-to-USDT side after one taker fee
execution_model.incremental_savings_definition: three-leg ending USDT-equivalent value versus the direct route less six bips, minus the maximum of zero and every feasible one-intermediary saving versus direct less three bips
execution_model.non_atomicity: all indirect routes are sequential and hypothetical; retained simultaneous top books prove neither completion nor fills

empirical_candidate_requires: all 60 retained snapshots evaluate with a feasible displayed-capacity direct route
all three path legs fit displayed top quantity in all 60 snapshots
combined source and two-intermediary residual value is at most one bip in all 60 snapshots
strictly positive incremental savings over the best shorter feasible route in at least 48 of 60 snapshots
at least 12 positive incremental observations in each consecutive 15-snapshot block
strictly positive median incremental savings across all 60 snapshots
accepted_edge_requires_additionally: an independently required legitimate same-account organic conversion without generated volume
exact same-account commissions discounts taxes filters and balances for every involved symbol
fresh finite-size depth immediately before the organic conversion
prospective paper or separately authorized owned evidence of sequential completion latency slippage residuals and failure unwind
positive recurrence across independent non-overlapping liquidity volatility and latency regimes

stop_rules: if zero empirical candidates survive do not build or run a three-leg live collector on this retained mechanism
do not weaken the best-shorter-route comparator fees residual capacity stress or recurrence gates after outcome access
do not treat cost savings as standalone arbitrage or create split rerouted self-matched or wash volume
do not access credentials accounts orders funds or protected capture state
